method: Manual rewrite of the complete 豆 and 斗 boundaries around their concrete vessel images, alignment of the 豈 compatibility form with 豈, and cleanup of seven learner-facing target glosses.

roots.reason: The independent character commonly means beans, while its graph depicts a high-footed bowl or vessel. A stemmed bowl is visually recoverable from the form and remains useful in the character's vessel, offering, food, and phonetic descendants.

The simplified character commonly carries fight from 鬥, while the older graph is a handled dipper or grain measure. Ladle is a compact concrete image that explains measuring, pouring, cup, and Big-Dipper associations better than treating every occurrence as a constellation.
This compatibility form of 豈 should inherit the same atomic victory-drum image instead of being decomposed into mountain plus beans.
